description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/filehandle.t is four rows.  PCL produces two of them; rows 2 and 3
("after 'seek' and 'tell', got expected current fh position" / "still got
expected content") are never produced and row 4 ("no errors after 'seek' or
'tell'") fails.

The file opens a handle with the TWO-ARGUMENT `open(FH, "<$file")` spelling,
seeks inside it and reads back.  Reproduce it directly before assuming the
2-arg spelling is the cause -- the file also uses a bareword handle and
`*{$fh}{IO}`, both of which are the #1664 typeglob-model family.  One `runt`
run of the file with stderr on prints the answer.
subject: `seek`/`tell` on a handle opened with the 2-argument open(FH, "<file") spelling (op/filehandle.t: 2 rows never produced, 1 fails)
